# Calum Lill

**Calum Andrew Lill** (born September 1995) is a British actor. He is best known for his portrayal of the villainous solicitor Joel Deering in the ITV soap opera *Coronation Street* from 2023 to 2024. Lill also appeared as PC Carlton Smith in the Channel 4 soap opera *Hollyoaks* in 2021 and has performed in various stage productions, including *The Sociable Plover* and pantomime roles.

## Early life and education
Calum Andrew Lill was born in September 1995 . He is from Manchester, England . Lill trained as an actor at the Liverpool Institute for Performing Arts (LIPA) .

## Career

### 2019–2023: Early roles and career struggles
After graduating, Lill began his television career in 2019 with guest appearances in British medical dramas. He played the character Chez Wilson-Needham in an episode of the BBC soap opera *Doctors* and portrayed Conor Henson in an episode of *Holby City* later that same year .

In 2021, Lill was cast in the Channel 4 soap opera *Hollyoaks* in the recurring role of PC Carlton Smith . He appeared in approximately 12 episodes, where his character was involved in a storyline regarding the abuse of John Paul McQueen by PC George Kiss .

Following his stint on *Hollyoaks*, Lill experienced a period of unemployment in the acting industry, exacerbated by the COVID-19 pandemic and the 2023 SAG-AFTRA strikes which affected the wider industry . During this hiatus, he worked various non-acting jobs to support himself, including selling cars and working at a paella stand at music festivals . Lill has stated in interviews that he found car sales difficult and unfulfilling, noting that he nearly quit the acting profession entirely due to financial pressures and a lack of roles . While working at the festival food stand, he met actors Rupert Hill and Jenny Platt, former *Coronation Street* cast members, who encouraged him to persist with his acting career .

### 2023–2025: *Coronation Street*
In 2023, Lill successfully auditioned for the ITV soap opera *Coronation Street*. He was working as a car salesman when he received the call from his agent confirming he had secured the part . He made his first on-screen appearance as Joel Deering, a duty solicitor, in September 2023 .

Initially introduced as a charming professional and a romantic interest for established character Dee-Dee Bailey (Channique Sterling-Brown), the character of Joel Deering was later revealed to be a "villain" involved in grooming and abusing vulnerable young women . The storyline escalated throughout 2024, revealing Joel as the secret assailant of the character Lauren Bolton (Cait Fitton), whom he had attacked and left for dead .

Lill's tenure on the show concluded with a high-profile "whodunit" storyline surrounding Joel Deering's death. The character was killed off in September 2024, with the identity of his killer kept secret from the audience until a flashback episode aired in November 2024 revealed that Lauren Bolton had struck the fatal blow in self-defense . Lill described the conclusion of the arc as "soap justice" .

Following his departure, it was confirmed in May 2025 that Lill would return to *Coronation Street* for a brief appearance, reportedly involving a single episode or flashback sequence .

### Theatre and other work
In addition to his television work, Lill has performed in theatre. In May 2025, he starred as "Dave" in a 20th-anniversary revival of Tim Whitnall's play *The Sociable Plover* at the Old Red Lion Theatre in Islington, London . Reviews praised his performance, with critics noting his ability to convey a "quiet air of menace" and comparing his stage presence to his television work .

Lill has also appeared in pantomime productions. He played the antagonist Fleshcreep in *Jack and the Beanstalk* at the Bournemouth Pavilion during the 2024/2025 Christmas season . He reprised the role of Fleshcreep for a production at the Oak Theatre in Scarisbrick, Lancashire, in December 2025 .

## Personal life
Lill resides in Manchester . He has been in a relationship with Roberta McClarron since 2021 . The couple announced their engagement in June 2024 . Lill proposed during a trip to the countryside; he later shared a humorous anecdote on social media revealing that he had to wear a swimsuit belonging to his *Coronation Street* co-star Dolly-Rose Campbell in the hot tub after his partner removed his swimwear from their suitcase as a prank .

## Filmography

### Television
| Year | Title | Role | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 2019 | *Doctors* | Chez Wilson-Needham | Guest role |
| 2019 | *Holby City* | Conor Henson | Guest role |
| 2021 | *Hollyoaks* | PC Carlton Smith | Recurring role (12 episodes) |
| 2023–2025 | *Coronation Street* | Joel Deering | Regular role (2023–2024); Guest (2025) |

### Theatre
| Year | Title | Role | Venue |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 2024–2025 | *Jack and the Beanstalk* | Fleshcreep | Bournemouth Pavilion |
| 2025 | *The Sociable Plover* | Dave | Old Red Lion Theatre |
| 2025 | *Jack and the Beanstalk* | Fleshcreep | Oak Theatre, Scarisbrick |

## Awards and nominations
| Year | Award | Category | Work | Result |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 2024 | Inside Soap Awards | Best Villain | *Coronation Street* | Nominated |
| 2025 | British Soap Awards | Villain of the Year | *Coronation Street* | Nominated |

3](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjc1jOv0Z1sULqEwtlHFnx59jr7NoTnHSfkU9xJz8mJ4IAMWYQ_EQMYGVZo28S59O8M6LVkWH_UxxgxxhZsKN7XmI795CG4tDAlvUHU8EniXLZx-mOl5nO9jJEgqPqvJyEAIGpS0_0t3EYs1zyUHWahVJg5feVJJCbrGOkEYIMB9vyE0591ro-n4eIN5VM/s320/Joel_Deering_Coronation_Street.png)](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjc1jOv0Z1sULqEwtlHFnx59jr7NoTnHSfkU9xJz8mJ4IAMWYQ_EQMYGVZo28S59O8M6LVkWH_UxxgxxhZsKN7XmI795CG4tDAlvUHU8EniXLZx-mOl5nO9jJEgqPqvJyEAIGpS0_0t3EYs1zyUHWahVJg5feVJJCbrGOkEYIMB9vyE0591ro-n4eIN5VM/s975/Joel_Deering_Coronation_Street.png) Since the character of solicitor Joel Deering first appeared on Corrie in September 2023, actor Calum Lill has brought something special to the Street. A show with a large cast, it's always a delight when someone with a strong screen presence joins, and it's unfortunate, from that point of view, that his character couldn't be more long-term. But, soap justice dictates that villains of his nature should get their comeuppance, and so once his dreadful crimes became known, it was always going to end with a departure of some sort. As readers will know, Joel's murder led to a 'whodunit' which has spanned the past number of weeks. The culprit was finally revealed in tonight's episode, and so fans who haven't caught up yet should look away now. [![Image 4](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhLg9-u_ntqwKOOEc_ZwEPJgueqXmPZD4DisLNnxBlEOAQ0J1eQx55OTJyJUOmx-IR5L_W5edAs8urtdCZpU2gBFZl-4oTg1LQ6NynYDmRLmFtawqfj8euiOgk4Da8xXr4Yw2JJVJLYhHGNylgyiqgddjeQg_PBO0ILnnpvwMQiyd1VGpHSZT3rvRG9lNA/s320/Calum_Lill_Emma_Hynes_Channique_Sterling_Brown_Coronation_Street.jpg)](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhLg9-u_ntqwKOOEc_ZwEPJgueqXmPZD4DisLNnxBlEOAQ0J1eQx55OTJyJUOmx-IR5L_W5edAs8urtdCZpU2gBFZl-4oTg1LQ6NynYDmRLmFtawqfj8euiOgk4Da8xXr4Yw2JJVJLYhHGNylgyiqgddjeQg_PBO0ILnnpvwMQiyd1VGpHSZT3rvRG9lNA/s4032/Calum_Lill_Emma_Hynes_Channique_Sterling_Brown_Coronation_Street.jpg) I had the pleasure of travelling to Coronation Street Studios in Manchester for a farewell interview with Calum. He came across as such a lovely person who is funny, humble, passionate, and so dedicated to his craft, and it was clear from Corrie staff there on the day that he is much missed since his departure. We got straight into finding out what it was like to play such a part, and to hear Calum's take on things. Joel's charm saw fellow solicitor Dee-Dee Bailey (Channique Sterling-Brown) fall in love with him, and their engagement follow. But it also disguised the truth of his terrible character, and the horrendous acts he was capable of committing. “At first, because I had to be under the radar, I had to try and be as beige as possible for as long as possible,” Calum explains. But the emergence of Joel's secret wife and child offered some indication that he wasn't all he seemed. “One of the plans was, he can't be perfect, so let's put in some sort of bad background,” Calum tells us, explaining that the intention behind their inclusion was to hopefully throw people off the scent of what were far more sinister elements to his character. His horrific abuse of young, vulnerable girls would be discovered in time, one of whom included his eventual killer, Lauren Bolton (Cait Fitton).
Photo: Danielle Baguley ITV
But this act of murder wasn't a certainty, as it appeared at one point that Joel may have attempted to fake his own death. Asked if he really thought he'd get away with it and escape by doing this, Calum says, “I think he did. He's so blindly arrogant of his own skill and his own ability. He thinks he's more intelligent than Lauren, the police and detectives. In a way, his own sheer arrogance was a big part of his downfall. He completely thought he could treat women how he wanted and it'd have absolutely no repercussions.” The night of 27 September is revealed now to have involved Ronnie and Ed Bailey pursuing Joel with a crowbar, Dee-Dee attacking him, Detective Kit Green threatening him, Lauren delivering the lethal blow and Max pushing him into the river. We're told this final episode was months in the planning. “It was as if we were filming a movie,” says Calum. “One of the scenes we spent about 12 hours shooting, and you've got all these different cameras, and green screen and special effects, and I'd never experienced anything like that before, so it was incredible.” He is so grateful for the opportunities the whole experience has given him, from the role itself to how his scenes were filmed. “I've played him nice, funny, boring, horrific,” he says of the different aspects of Joel's character, “and then I've managed to do the soap stuff, and then on location, and also on this movie set.” The studios in Gorton, Manchester, where his final scenes on the bridge were filmed, have been home to high-end film and television productions such as Peaky Blinders, and Calum gave us some insight into the state-of-the-art technology involved, and the experience of working there.
Photo: Danielle Baguley ITV
“They go out to the real bridge and take 360 degree videos of the whole place,” he explains. Then, in a massive black room at the studio, the footage is shown on a semi-circle of screens, and the set sits in the middle. “We've got this long railway bridge that we've built,” he reveals, “and that's on a table that turns. The camera stays where it is, the train track moves and the whole background is synced as if the camera is moving in the real place.” He says, “it was incredible to have gotten that opportunity. It was amazing. I'm looking forward to seeing it; I can't wait.” Someone who was also undoubtedly looking forward to tuning in tonight is Calum's Grandma who has featured on his [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/calumlill/) watching and reacting to the twists and turns of Joel's story. “I get a text still after every episode,” Calum says. The last one read _Blinking heck, is Kit in the frame now? You really know how to antagonise people. I'm so glad it's not real._ followed by _I watch it every time. You were really bad. That's a compliment. As always, so proud. “_She's so adorable,” says Calum. “I love her so much.” You'll have undoubtedly gotten the sense by now that Calum is such a genuine and endearing person to speak with, and it was lovely to hear what his experience at Coronation Street has meant to him. “I hadn't worked for two years before this,” he says, and while hard to believe given his talent, therein lies the reality of life as an actor for many. He told us, “I really struggled to find my feet as I started, and for about six months, watching myself back, I was just beating myself up. It just took that time to try and get into the character. I worked so hard,” he says. “I just said, if I give this 100% and I leave and don't work for years, at least I know there's no more I could have done.” His typical day during his busiest three or four months involved a 5.30am start, working for 15 hours, getting home at 10.30pm and quickly having food berfore spending another two hours learning lines.
Photo: Danielle Baguley ITV
“I am proud of my work,” Calum says, when asked, “not necessarily 'cos I think I'm great, I've not had the opportunity to work that hard before, and I did.” He adds, “I also feel so honoured and proud of everyone else involved. There are hundreds of people in the making of this storyline and I've just been able to be put as the spearhead of it....I'm the one that gets the credit for it in the street, and I'm so grateful to have been given this opportunity. I miss it here so much, and I miss the people so much 'cos they're just the most incredible people. This is such a magical place to work, and although I only got 15 months here, it's definitely been the best time of my life.” Asked if he's taken anything of Joel's, Calum reveals, “I've got a lot of his costume. His smart-casual stuff is nicer than any of my stuff, so I'm absolutely kitted out now. And I've got the murder weapon at home.” He says of the prop that dealt the fatal blow, “The one that I've got is like a brick that would've been part of the bridge; I've got the foam soft version. Not soft enough to be hit as hard as I was getting hit in the face repeatedly by Cait," he jokes, "but softer than a brick nonetheless. Duncan the director said, _We can tell that you're being too gentle with him,_ and I was like, _Cait we've worked together for so long, make sure and sell this, this is the last bit, go for it._ She did!” Next up, Calum will be playing the part of the giant's villainous henchman in the [Jack and the Beanstalk Panto](https://www.bournemouthpavilion.co.uk/events/jack-the-beanstalk-2024) in Bournemouth. He says, “I was reading the scripts the other day. My approach for Joel was like, _What's he thinking?_ and _What's he doing?_ and listening to dark music with headphones in rocking in a corner. So I was trying to do the same approach for this and I was like, this is a gag to the audience about magic beans versus baked beans; I don't need to tear myself to pieces in a corner listening to scary music.” He adds, “I've got the unbroken streak of playing villains. Maybe one day someone will give me a chance to play someone that's not a baddie, we'll see.” After the performance he has put in on Corrie, I know I would certainly watch him in any role! It was such a pleasure to chat with Calum, both during our interview and afterwards in the Rovers, and I hope more great things lie ahead for him, because he very much deserves it. By Emma Hynes _Read all about my recent trip to Coronation Street in [A Rover Returns](https://coronationstreetupdates.blogspot.com/2024/11/a-rover-returns.html)._ ** Web** Calum Lill bowed out of Weatherfield in dramatic style last night and is now looking forward to the future
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Calum Lill bid farewell to Coronation Street for the final time last night. The soap star bowed out as the killer of his onscreen counterpart, Joel Deering, was finally unveiled.

Last night's [episode](https://www.liverpoolecho.co.uk/all-about/coronation-street) revealed Lauren Bolton struck the final blow that killed the villainous solicitor. In his official exit interview, Calum revealed Joel's end couldn't have been more fitting as it was a true example of soap justice.

He told the [ECHO and other press](https://www.liverpoolecho.co.uk/news/showbiz-news/itv-coronation-street-joel-deering-30367221): "That's the best justice he could have got. He attacked her viciously and nearly killed her so for it to come full circle and for him to get his comeuppance from the person he attacked when she was vulnerable and defenceless, it's what he deserves."

Calum issued an emotional announcement as his final [episode](https://www.liverpoolecho.co.uk/all-about/coronation-street) as Joel was broadcast last night. He couldn't hold back the tears as he said: "For me when I found out I had this part, it was like Harry Potter getting his letter to find out he was going to Hogwarts.

READ MORE: [BBC Strictly Come Dancing's Sarah Hadland shares 'traumatised' admission as Vito Coppola warns 'stop'](https://www.liverpoolecho.co.uk/news/showbiz-news/bbc-strictly-come-dancings-sarah-30374507)READ MORE: [BBC Strictly Come Dancing's Ellie Leach declares love for co-star as she arrives in Merseyside](https://www.liverpoolecho.co.uk/news/showbiz-news/bbc-strictly-come-dancings-ellie-30370810)He added: "\[Corrie\] is just the most magical place and I just want to say thank you to the friends I've made. The people here are so special.

"And in every department they're just so great and I'm going to miss them terribly. But I'm so happy that I got to experience it.

"So thank you. And I can't wait to watch you all on screen from home and watch your careers. It's been amazing. So thank you."

Content cannot be displayed without consent

Calum told the [ECHO](https://www.liverpoolecho.co.uk/) and other press that he hadn't worked for two years before landing the job on Corrie and he initially struggled with self-confidence issues when playing Joel. He said: "I really struggled to find my feet.

"As I started and for about six months, I'd watch myself back and beat myself up. I'd watch the episodes with my fiancée and she'd know to leave me for a bit because I'd just be beating myself up. It just took that time to get into that character."

Calum eventually grew into the role and is proud of what he achieved as he won acclaim for his portrayal. He added: "There's definitely better actors than me but I don't think anyone could have put in as much work as I did. If I give this 100% and I leave and I don't work for years, at least there was no more that I could have done.

"I was up at 5.30, I'd be in work for about 15 hours, get home about 10.30 at night, eat some food quickly, then I'd go and do another two hours of learning lines. Do it again for about three or months.

"Looking back now, I've finished and I can sleep. I have time and I can see my friends. But that's probably the happiest time I've had. I am proud of my work. Not necessarily because I think I'm great. I've just not had the opportunity to work that hard before."

Calum is now excited for the future and is looking forward to a [pantomime stint](https://www.liverpoolecho.co.uk/whats-on/whats-on-news/) in Jack and the Beanstalk over the festive season that won't be as mentally taxing as playing Joel. He said: "I was reading the scripts the other day and my approach for Joel was like, 'What's he thinking and what's he doing?' Listening to dark music with headphones in, rocking in a corner.

"I was trying to do the same approach with this and I was like this is a gag to the audience about magic beans vs baked beans. I don't need to tear myself to pieces in a corner listening to scary music.

"I think it's going to be a nice welcome break from attacking teenage girls. I've got the unbroken streak of playing villains. Maybe one day someone will give me a chance to play some one who is not a baddie, we'll see."

Calum has lots to be excited about for the future as he looks to build on the experience he received on Corrie. Away from the screen, the actor proposed to his long-time partner, Roberta, and was flooded with support when he reflected on the family update with a heartfelt tribute earlier this year.

He said: "Ah my partner in crime. For the last year I’ve been totally focused on my career which has meant you have come second and I’ve hardly seen you.

"Some people might have gotten upset or p\*\*\*\*d off at this, but you have done nothing but support me in chasing my dream. On top of your own job, you’ve looked after our home.

"You’ve done pretty much all of the cooking & cleaning, all my washing, the pots, the decorating, and you’ve taken it in your stride and never grumbled even on the many days when I was gone before you woke up and got into bed after you were asleep.

"You did this because you knew it’s what I needed and you supported me completely. I’m so grateful to have you in my life and that you agreed to marry me. Thanks for being amazing. Here’s some of my favourite pics."

Content cannot be displayed without consent

Channique Sterling-Brown, who plays Dee Dee Bailey, said: "An absolute queen" Cait Fitton, who plays Lauren Bolton, added: "She’s ace" Julia Goulding, who plays Shona Platt, added: "You two."

Calum has previously hailed the support Roberta gave him as he battled to get his break in acting, which happened when he landed the role on Corrie. He said: "Roberta is incredible. When I told her I got the role, she was screaming and crying. I was crying too. She knew I’d been putting on a brave face and it was a huge relief that 15 years of hard work paid off and I wouldn't have to quit.

"There's no shame in quitting. So many people have to. It's one of the hardest industries to get into. But to know I didn't have to was incredible."

Calum has previously acted in Hollyoaks and Holby City but said roles dried up as the pandemic hit Before his job in Corrie, Calum worked as a car salesman while he was auditioning to make his Weatherfield dream a reality. He said: "I was selling cars while auditioning for Corrie and I hated it. I thought, 'It's been 15 years, I'm going to have to drop it, nothing's happening."

However, his fantasy became a reality when he landed the role as Joel and he is now looking forward to the future after he succeeded and won acclaim in his dream role. He said: "I thought they were calling to tell me I’d not got it. I walked out onto the forecourt, I was between two cars. My agent said: 'Calum?' There was a silence that lasted for about ten minutes and then I heard 'You got it'.

“Like the absolute drama queen that I am, I just fell to my knees and was crying and sobbing, I couldn't speak. I was over the moon.”

[![Image 1: This is a good article. Click here for more information.](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/thumb/9/94/Symbol_support_vote.svg/20px-Symbol_support_vote.svg.png)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Good_articles* "This is a good article. Click here for more information.")

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

| Calum Lill
 |
| --- |
| Born | 1995 or 1996 (age 29–30) |
| Occupations | Actor  
Car salesman |
| Years active | 2019– |
| Television | _[Coronation Street](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coronation_Street "Coronation Street")_ |
| Partner | Roberta McClarron (2021–) |

**Calum Lill** (born 1995 or 1996) is a British actor. After graduating, Lill had guest roles in _[Doctors](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doctors_/(2000_TV_series/) "Doctors (2000 TV series)")_ and _[Holby City](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Holby_City "Holby City")_ in 2019, and he played the recurring role of [Carlton Smith](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carlton_Smith "Carlton Smith") in the soap opera _[Hollyoaks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hollyoaks "Hollyoaks")_ in 2021. Lill almost quit the acting profession due to his struggle in getting acting roles and worked various jobs in between acting, including as a car salesman, which he did not like. Lill was later cast as [Joel Deering](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joel_Deering "Joel Deering") in the [ITV](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ITV_/(TV_network/) "ITV (TV network)") soap opera _[Coronation Street](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coronation_Street "Coronation Street")_, which he was very happy about. Lill enjoyed his experience on the soap and received praise for his portrayal of the villain and was nominated for [_Inside Soap_ Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inside_Soap_Awards "Inside Soap Awards") and a [British Soap Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/British_Soap_Award "British Soap Award"). Lill left the role at the end of the storyline in 2024 and he then portrayed Fleshcreep in the pantomime of _[Jack and the Beanstalk](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jack_and_the_Beanstalk "Jack and the Beanstalk")_. In 2025, Lill announced that he would be acting in _The Sociable Plover_ at the [Old Red Lion, Islington](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Old_Red_Lion,_Islington "Old Red Lion, Islington"), and that same year it was also announced that he would be briefly returning to _Coronation Street_.

Early life and career
---------------------

\[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Calum_Lill&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Early life and career")\]

### Early life and career

\[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Calum_Lill&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Early life and career")\]

Calum Lill was born into a working-class family, in 1995 or 1996.[\[1\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Interview_2-1)[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal-2) When he was a child, he watched the drama _[Waterloo Road](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Waterloo_Road_/(TV_series/) "Waterloo Road (TV series)")_, which he considered his favourite show.[\[3\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Joel_1-3) He revealed, "All I wanted to do was get an acting job in _Waterloo Road_ when I was growing up".[\[3\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Joel_1-3) Lill also revealed that his house was used as one of the sets during the early years of _Waterloo Road_ just as his family were moving out from it.[\[3\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Joel_1-3)

Shortly after he graduated, Lill portrayed lead guest character Chez Wilson-Needham in an episode of the [BBC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BBC "BBC") soap opera _[Doctors](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doctors_/(2000_TV_series/) "Doctors (2000 TV series)")_, which aired in 2019.[\[4\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Doctors-4)[\[5\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Doctors_2-5) Speaking of the experience, Lill said, "it was two days filming and you'd think I'd just been cast as the lead in the new [Scorsese](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Martin_Scorsese "Martin Scorsese") epic".[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal-2) He also portrayed Conor Henson in a 2019 episode of _[Holby City](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Holby_City "Holby City")_, which Lill described as "fantastic".[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal-2)[\[6\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal_2-6)[\[7\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Holby-7) The [COVID-19 lockdown in the United Kingdom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/COVID-19_lockdown_in_the_United_Kingdom "COVID-19 lockdown in the United Kingdom") then occurred, which hindered Lill's plans.[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal-2) Due to the television industry shutting down, Lill nearly became homeless during the pandemic.[\[6\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal_2-6) Lill recalled to the _Me, Myself and Hopefully You..?_ podcast in 2021, "It's a hustle. That's what a lot of theatre actors struggle with. They love theatre, but it only pays enough to cover your rent while in you're in the job... You've then got to go back to waiting tables".[\[6\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal_2-6) In 2021, he portrayed the recurring role of [Carlton Smith](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carlton_Smith "Carlton Smith") in the soap opera _[Hollyoaks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hollyoaks "Hollyoaks")_ for 12 episodes.[\[8\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-8)[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal-2)[\[9\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-9)

In between acting roles, Lill had various jobs, including a stint working at Junkyard Golf Club.[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal-2) Lill moved from London to Manchester with his girlfriend and worked alongside acting to save money for a house.[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal-2)[\[1\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Interview_2-1) Lill found this experience very difficult and was not happy in the non-acting job that he was doing, and he almost quit his acting career.[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal-2)[\[10\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Quit-10) At one point, Lill auditioned for the soap opera _[Coronation Street](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coronation_Street "Coronation Street")_ but was unsuccessful, which made him upset as he wanted to be on the soap due to being working-class and Northern.[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal-2) Lill then worked at a paella stand at festivals where he met actors [Rupert Hill](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rupert_Hill "Rupert Hill"), the brother of the owner of the stand, and his wife [Jenny Platt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jenny_Platt "Jenny Platt"), both of whom had appeared in the soap.[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal-2)[\[11\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-11) The actors reassured him that the producers of _Coronation Street_ would contact him if they liked him.[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal-2)[\[12\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Quit_2-12) Whilst auditioning for the soap, he worked as a car salesman, which he hated.[\[10\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Quit-10)[\[12\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Quit_2-12)

In August 2023, it was announced that Lill had joined the cast of _Coronation Street_ as [Joel Deering](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joel_Deering "Joel Deering"), a solicitor who would become the new love interest for [Dee Dee Bailey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dee_Dee_Bailey "Dee Dee Bailey") ([Channique Sterling-Brown](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Channique_Sterling-Brown "Channique Sterling-Brown")).[\[13\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-13)[\[14\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-14) Lill described being cast in the soap as "incredible", adding, "I've never felt anything like it. I was walking on air...especially being a working class northern lad".[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal-2) He added, "It was a relief that 14 or 15 years had paid off and I wouldn't have to quit. There's no shame in quitting... But to know I didn't have to was incredible".[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal-2) He auditioned for the role in May 2023 initially believed that he had been unsuccessful.[\[1\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Interview_2-1)[\[6\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal_2-6) When Lill's agent told him that he had received the part, he fell to his knees and cried and could not speak as he was "over the moon".[\[10\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Quit-10) The actor called getting a regular role on the soap the equivalent of getting his "letter for [Hogwarts](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hogwarts "Hogwarts")".[\[15\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Interview-15) Lill revealed that _Coronation Street_ spent a lot of money on the character's outfits.[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal-2) Lill would wake up at 5:30am to read the scripts and arrive to work for 7am and stay until about 8–9pm.[\[1\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Interview_2-1)

> "When you're doing 40 pages a day then you finish and need to learn 40 pages for the next few days, it's so relentless... it's such a skill, a baptism by fire. That was the most challenging. Everyone says you'll leave a different actor then when you started, because you can't not learn and develop so fast from the sheer volume of work."

–Lill on working on _Coronation Street_ (2024)[\[16\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Joel_2-16)

Joel was initially portrayed as a "good guy" but was later revealed to be a villain who was grooming and abusing girls and had tried to murder [Lauren Bolton](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lauren_Bolton "Lauren Bolton") ([Cait Fitton](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cait_Fitton "Cait Fitton")), who had been presumed dead for months.[\[17\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Prop-17) Lill had known that Joel was going to be a villain and found out just how "bad" Joel was as he got further into auditions, and he was initially unaware of how the plot would end as it "kept changing".[\[3\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Joel_1-3) Lill enjoyed portraying Joel's villainous side, as he found it more fun, but did not "camp it up" due to the storyline being a serious matter.[\[15\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Interview-15) He was also uncomfortable with portraying some of the things that the character did due to it being so dark, but the crew supported him with it.[\[15\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Interview-15)[\[18\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Interview_3-18) Lill researched for the role by watching hours of police interviews with serial killer [Ted Bundy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ted_Bundy "Ted Bundy") and speaking to the Maggie Oliver Foundation, a charity that supports survivors of sexual exploitation and abuse.[\[1\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Interview_2-1) The actor would listen to music to get into character, ranging from sad, melancholy and drum and bass, but he noted that he could no longer listen to that music for pleasure as it would remind him of Joel.[\[19\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-19) Lill joked that several viewers had recognised him in public but did not speak to him as he plays a villain, but he believed that he had created "some sort of separation" between him and the character due to being active on social media.[\[16\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Joel_2-16) Lill expected to receive a negative backlash but found most of the response to be supportive.[\[15\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Interview-15) He added that he only began to get noticed by viewers when Joel was revealed to be involved with Lauren.[\[20\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-20) Fitton and Lill got on well together and went the "extra mile" to make their scenes believable by distancing from each other on set and being in character when they passed each other.[\[21\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-21) Lill found an episode that was mostly him and Fitton to be the most challenging part of his time on the soap, but they felt "privileged" to be "trusted" with it.[\[16\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Joel_2-16) In order to protect the secret from viewers that Lauren was alive, Lill would hide Fitton in the boot of his car when entering the set gates in order to sneak her into the building.[\[22\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-22) Lill joked on [Instagram](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Instagram "Instagram") that he struggled to act with the child actress who played Joel's daughter [Maeve Wilkinson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Coronation_Street_characters_introduced_in_2024#Maeve_Wilkinson "List of Coronation Street characters introduced in 2024") as he died "of cuteness overload every take".[\[23\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-23) However, Lill also revealed that criticise himself when he would watch his scenes in episodes but added, "I worked so hard. I know that there's definitely better actors than me but I don't think anybody else could have put in as much work as I did. Because I just said, if I can give this 100% and I leave and I don't work for years, at least I know that there's no more I could have done".[\[24\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-CS_exit-24)

In July 2024, it was announced that Lill had been cast as the villain Fleshcreep in [Bournemouth Pavilion](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pavilion_Theatre,_Bournemouth "Pavilion Theatre, Bournemouth")'s pantomime of _[Jack and the Beanstalk](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jack_and_the_Beanstalk "Jack and the Beanstalk")_, which ran from December 2024 to January 2025.[\[25\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-CS_exit_2-25)[\[26\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Jack-26)[\[27\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-27) Lill joked that he had a "streak" of playing villains.[\[28\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Inside_Gossip-28) He added that he was looking forward to doing comedy.[\[18\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Interview_3-18) Lill's casting in the production sparked rumours that Lill would be exiting _Coronation Street_ due to ITV usually not allowing actors to star in pantomimes while they are contracted, though it was reported that Lill had always meant to have a finite run on the soap.[\[25\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-CS_exit_2-25) His departure was confirmed the following month.[\[29\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-29) The character was [killed-off](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Killed-off "Killed-off") in a [Whodunit](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Whodunit "Whodunit") mystery storyline in September 2024, and the killer was revealed to be Lauren that November in a flashback episode.[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal-2) Lill he did not want to leave the soap as he had made some good friends there, calling it "the most incredible place to work" and "the best year" of his life.[\[15\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Interview-15)[\[16\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Joel_2-16) The ending changed several times, which kept Lill on his "toes".[\[18\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Interview_3-18) Lill had left the show in July 2024 but returned to film the flashback episode.[\[24\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-CS_exit-24) Lill revealed that when he left the soap, he took several of the character's outfits, including his "smart casual stuff" which he considered "nicer" than any of his own smart outfits, with permission.[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal-2)[\[30\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-30) He also took home the "soft foam" prop of the brick that was used to kill Joel.[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal-2) Lill's co-stars got him several leaving presents, including a St Christopher's pendant.[\[18\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Interview_3-18)[\[31\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-31) Lill said that leaving his colleagues would be the most difficult thing of leaving the soap as he believed that they were the "just the best in the world".[\[32\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-32)

For his role as Joel, Lill was shortlisted for "Best Villain" at the [2024 _Inside Soap_ Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inside_Soap_Awards#2024 "Inside Soap Awards"), whilst Joel being revealed as Lauren's mystery boyfriend was shortlisted for "Best Showstopper" and Lauren's disappearance was longlisted for "Best Storyline".[\[33\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-2024_award-33)[\[34\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-34)[\[35\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-2024_Shortlist-35) In 2025, Lill was longlisted for [Villain of the Year](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Villain_of_the_Year "Villain of the Year") at the [British Soap Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/British_Soap_Awards "British Soap Awards").[\[36\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-36)[\[37\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-BSA_longlist-37)[\[38\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Sociable_Plover-38) He made the shortlist.[\[39\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-39)[\[40\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-40) Gary Brocart-Gillatt from _[Inside Soap](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inside_Soap "Inside Soap")_ wrote that he enjoyed the "camp touches" that Lill brought to his villainous character.[\[41\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-41) Lill spoke to James Chase, who plays [Tom King](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thomas_King_/(Emmerdale/) "Thomas King (Emmerdale)") in another soap opera _[Emmerdale](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emmerdale "Emmerdale")_, at an awards ceremony as they both related to playing villains in soap operas and received hate messages online.[\[28\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Inside_Gossip-28) In November 2024, Lill appeared on _[Good Morning Britain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Good_Morning_Britain_/(2014_TV_programme/) "Good Morning Britain (2014 TV programme)")_, where promoted the details of an [ITV](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ITV_/(TV_network/) "ITV (TV network)") competition to viewers.[\[42\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-42) In April 2025, Lill announced that he would be acting in [Tim Whitnall](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tim_Whitnall "Tim Whitnall")'s play _The Sociable Plover_ at the [Old Red Lion, Islington](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Old_Red_Lion,_Islington "Old Red Lion, Islington") from 13–24 May that year.[\[38\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Sociable_Plover-38) That same month, it was reported that Lill would briefly reprise his role of Joel on _Coronation Street_ in an unknown storyline.[\[43\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-CS_return-43) In October 2025, it was announced that Lill would be a celebrity judge on _Worksop's Got Talent_.[\[44\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-44)

Lill has dated Roberta McClarron, who works in [public relations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public_relations "Public relations") and marketing, since December 2021.[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal-2) When he was cast on _Coronation Street_, he lived with his girlfriend and his brother, who knew about Joel turning out to be a villain.[\[1\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Interview_2-1) Lill said that McClarron was very happy for him when he was cast on _Coronation Street_ as she knew how much he was struggling emotionally due to his struggles in getting acting jobs.[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal-2)[\[45\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-45) McClaron got on well with Sterling-Brown; they had a group chat with McClaron's friend called "The Girls Featuring Calum".[\[15\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Interview-15) In June 2024, the couple announced their engagement.[\[6\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Personal_2-6)[\[46\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-46) That September, Lill paid tribute to McClarron on [Instagram](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Instagram "Instagram"), where he thanked her for supporting him and his acting career and noted that he had not seen her much during his time on _Coronation Street_ but she still supported him and did the housework so that Lill could put the soap first, with Lill writing, "I'm so grateful to have you in my life and that you agreed to marry me. Thanks for being amazing".[\[47\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-47)[\[15\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Interview-15) Lill said in 2024 that he was friends with actor Tyler Dobbs, who also portrayed a villain in _Coronation Street_.[\[1\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Interview_2-1) In May 2024, Lill took part in the AJ Bell Great Manchester Run with other _Coronation Street_ actors to raise money for charity.[\[48\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-48) Lill filmed a video of his grandmother reacting to Joel being revealed as a villain, which became popular with _Coronation Street_ viewers; Lill attributed this to viewers seeing him as "Calum the actor" rather than his character.[\[49\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-49) In the first half of 2025, Lill travelled around [Southeast Asia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Southeast_Asia "Southeast Asia").[\[38\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calum_Lill#cite_note-Sociable_Plover-38)

The chilling details of Joel Deering's demise in [Coronation Street](https://www.mirror.co.uk/all-about/coronation-street) were unveiled in the latest episode, with [Lauren Bolton being outed as his murderer.](https://www.mirror.co.uk/tv/tv-news/itv-coronation-street-fans-rumble-34104529) Following the revelation that Lauren dealt the fatal blow, actor [Calum Lill](https://www.mirror.co.uk/tv/tv-news/breaking-itv-coronation-street-star-33444588) has bid farewell to the show.

‌  

Reflecting on his departure, Calum shared some behind-the-scenes insights: "I’ve got the murder weapon at home," he admitted. "It’s like a brick that would have been part of the bridge, so I’ve got the foam soft version. Not soft enough to be hit as hard as I was in the face repeatedly by Cait \[Fitton\], but softer than a brick nonetheless."

‌  

READ MORE: [First look as Selling Sunset star lands huge role on Neighbours](https://www.mirror.co.uk/tv/tv-news/first-look-selling-sunset-star-34100399)

![Image 3: Coronation Street's Lauren and Joel](https://i2-prod.mirror.co.uk/article34109400.ece/ALTERNATES/s1200e/1_JS342724173-2.jpg)

View 4 Images

Joel's killer turned out to be Lauren

‌  

Calum's character left the soap in July, but he made a comeback this month for the dramatic exit scenes. The actor described the unique filming experience. "I came back for my final episode – it was nice to come back and see everyone – and it was like we were filming a movie," he recounted.

"We spent 12 hours shooting one of the scenes. We had different cameras and green screens and special effects. I’ve never experienced anything like that before – it was incredible. The location has been used for the Peaky Blinders movie, House Of Guinness, The Talamasca – all these big productions – and us."

Before securing his spot on the Corrie cast, Callum revealed he had a two-year hiatus from acting. During that time, [he took on various jobs, from selling cars to working food stands at festivals.](https://www.mirror.co.uk/tv/tv-news/itv-coronation-streets-joel-deering-32111798)

‌  

![Image 4: Coronation Street actor Calum Lill](https://i2-prod.mirror.co.uk/article34093339.ece/ALTERNATES/s1200e/1_Inside-Soap-Awards-2024-Arrivals.jpg)

View 4 Images

Calum has left his role after 15 months on the soap(Image: Mike Marsland/WireImage)

He confessed that despite acting being his passion, the journey was challenging. Calum candidly confessed, "I really struggled to find my feet as I started. For about six months, watching the episodes back, I was beating myself up. I'd watch the episodes with my fiancée and I'd go upstairs and she'd know to leave me for a bit because I was beating myself up. It took that time to try and get into the character."

He further added, "I worked so hard. I know that there's definitely better actors than me but I don't think anybody else could have put in as much work as I did. Because I just said, if I can give this 100% and I leave and I don't work for years, at least I know that there's no more I could have done."

‌  

![Image 5: Calum Lill in panto](https://i2-prod.mirror.co.uk/article34107475.ece/ALTERNATES/s1200e/2_JS351652374-1.jpg)

View 4 Images

Calum is still taking on a live audience when he takes on panto this Christmas

Despite a hectic 15 months, Calum isn't slowing down and has already secured a new role in panto. The star of the cobbles will portray the 'baddie' in Jack and the Beanstalk in the Bournemouth production.

Actor Calum Lill discussed his return as he confirmed he'll be back for one episode
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Coronation Street actor Calum Lill appeared on This Morning as he teased viewers over his return to Weatherfield after his dramatic exit.

Actor Calum Lill took on the role of villainous Joel Deering in 2023. The charming solicitor made Dee-Dee Bailey fall in love with him, keeping his true colours under wraps.

However, soon viewers saw the real Joel - a man who used his position of wealth and power to target younger, underprivileged girls who needed his help.

This led him to troubled Lauren [Bolton](https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/all-about/bolton) who eventually went missing after he viciously attacked her in her own flat. Although Roy Cropper was originally blamed for her "murder", it was Dee-Dee who uncovered the truth but didn't have enough hard evidence to get him locked away.

After a manhunt for Joel took place after he tried to abort Lauren's baby (who he was the biological father of), he wound up dead after a confrontation with Max Turner. Lauren hit him over the head as he held Max over the river.

With Joel Deering dead - or so we currently believe - Corrie producer Kate Brooks teased: "We obviously have Dee-Dee as well in 2025. Just when you thought the Joel story had come to an end, there is another chapter that happens that is going to completely upend Dee-Dee’s life."

While it's been rumoured that Joel will return in some capacity, actor Calum Lill confirmed his appearance while chatting to soap expert Sharon Marshall on This Morning.

He cryptically teased: "I couldn’t possibly tell you, all I can tell you is it’s one episode and stay tuned" when asked if Joel is really dead or if he comes back as a ghost.

Calum is also nominated for Villain of the Year at the British Soap Awards, as he added: "It’s amazing, such a gift to be nominated for it. It means I get to come back and see my friends when we do the awards, that’s the main thing."

Some viewers theorised that [Joel Deering's return](https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/news/tv/coronation-street-fans-rumble-reason-31743024) could be down to Lisa Swain potentially dobbing Kit Green in, but there's been no confirmation by the [ITV](https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/all-about/itv) soap at the time of writing.

At the time of his exit, Calum spoke to Manchester Evening News and shared: "I'm proud of what I did but also feel so honoured and proud of everyone else involved. There's hundreds of people involved in the making of this storyline.

"Just being able to be put as the spearhead of it, put at the front and get the compliments, there's hundreds of people working on the set, the costume, the make-up, the lighting, everything. I'm the one who gets the credit in the street.

"I'm so grateful to be given the opportunity and I miss it here so much. I miss the people so much because they're just the most incredible people. And although I only got 15 months here, it was the best time of my life."

Coronation Street star Calum Lill has announced his engagement to girlfriend Roberta McClaron with some loved-up photographs, following a romantic proposal.

The actor is best known for portraying [Joel Deering](https://www.entertainmentdailyuk.com/soaps/coronation-street-star-calum-lill-explains-why-joel-killed-lauren/) in the ITV soap, and has also starred in Hollyoaks and Doctors in the past.

Calum shared the happy news on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/calumlill/), with fans flocking to wish him and his new fiancée Roberta well.

![Image 1: Joel looking shady on the phone in Corrie](https://cdn.entertainmentdaily.com/2024/06/11105250/28_06_coro_joel_dee_dee_01-400x225.jpg)

Calum portrays Joel Deering in Coronation Street (Credit: ITV)

### Coronation Street star Calum Lill announces engagement

Calum announced he’d proposed to Roberta on Sunday, June 16 in a sweet Instagram post, along with the caption: “About time I made an honest woman of her,” with a ring emoji.

One snap showed Calum and Roberta cuddling up to one another as they smiled for the camera. Roberta showed off her stunning ring with her hand placed on her fiancé’s chest.

**JOIN ED!’S CORONATION STREET CHANNEL ON WHATSAPP – IN THESE 4 SIMPLE STEPS USING THE LINK** [**HERE**](https://www.whatsapp.com/channel/0029VaGLM0R8PgsBE9Eyqz0e)

![Image 2: ED Coronation Street WhatsApp call to action advert](https://cdn.entertainmentdaily.com/2024/01/24132540/ED-WhatsApp-1-400x333.png)

In the second photo, the Joel Deering actor could be seen sporting a black swimming costume. He explained that the swimsuit belonged to his [Coronation Street](https://www.entertainmentdailyuk.com/coronation-street/) co-star Dolly-Rose Campbell, who plays Gemma Winter.

“Celebrated with drinks in the hot tub but Roberta thought it would be funny to remove my swimming shorts from the suitcase. Thanks @dolly\_rose\_campbell for lending me your spare cossie. I think I rocked it tbf,” the star, who joined Corrie in 2023, added.

![Image 3: Coronation Street's Calum Lill](https://cdn.entertainmentdaily.com/2024/06/17125653/CORO-CALUM-LILL-ED-400x209.jpg)

Calum proposed to his partner (Credit: ITV)

### Coronation Street co-stars congratulate Calum Lill on big news

Dozens of Calum’s followers left well wishes and congratulatory messages in the comments, including many of his Coronation Street co-stars.

Channique Sterling-Brown, who plays his on-screen girlfriend Dee-Dee, said: “Congratulations, you gorgeous pair,” and Cait Fitton, who starred as Lauren Bolton, added: “Congratulations to both of you.”

Meanwhile, Bethany Platt actress [Lucy Fallon](https://www.entertainmentdailyuk.com/lucy-fallon) said: “Congratulations guys!!!!!” and Corrie newcomer Emrhys Cooper added: “Yay! Congrats buddy. So happy for you both.”

The happy couple have been dating since 2020, with the couple regularly sharing loved-up photos on Instagram from holidays and date nights.

Calum Lill was so close to quitting acting when he landed a part in [Coronation Street](https://www.mirror.co.uk/all-about/coronation-street) that he “fell to his knees, sobbing” with relief when the offer came through.

‌  

The actor, who plays Joel Deering, the new boyfriend of Channique Sterling-Brown’s solicitor Dee-Dee Bailey, said he was put through a rigorous audition process for the soap. It went on for weeks and at the time Calum was hating his job as a car salesman.

‌  

But he feared he was never going to get the break he needed to make a living from acting as the deadline for hearing about the gig had passed. He explained: “I took myself off to the key safe cupboard. I had a little cry to myself, and was like, ‘It’s OK, you’ve not got it. So close, but so far’.

“And then my phone started vibrating in my pocket, and it was my agent. I walked on to the forecourt. And he went, ‘You got it’. And, like the absolute drama queen that I am, I just fell to my knees. I was sobbing. I couldn’t speak.

“I was getting to the age where we wanted to save up for a house. And I just thought, ‘98% of actors don’t act full-time. Unfortunately, I think I’m in that 98%’.”

Calum, 28, who played PC Carlton Smith in Hollyoaks, said his first day on the set in Salford blew his mind. “I felt like Julia Roberts in Pretty Woman. I was just walking past people I’ve known in my living room since I was five... and I was like, ‘This is insane’.”

Article continues below

Calum previously revealed that he was nearly “homeless” during the COVID-19 lockdown due to the shutdown of the television industry. He told the ‘Me, Myself and Hopefully You…?’ podcast in 2021: "Most actors, despite being professional actors, you still have to have a job to do, between jobs.

"Unless you're in the top one per cent. It's a hustle. That's what a lot of theatre actors struggle with. They love theatre, but it only pays enough to cover your rent while in you're in the job...You've then got to go back to waiting tables."

[Coronation Street's](https://www.mirror.co.uk/all-about/coronation-street) Calum Lill had an unexpected job before taking on the role of Joel Deering.

‌  

The actor has starred in Waterloo Road, Hollyoaks and Holby City. He is currently wrapped up in an intense story line on the [ITV](https://www.mirror.co.uk/all-about/itv) soap, making it his biggest yet. Joel is set to come under [fire](https://www.mirror.co.uk/all-about/fire) as his girlfriend Dee-Dee Bailey, played by Channique Sterling-Brown, discovers he is hiding a big secret from her.

‌  

"Joel has a wife, Emily, and a young daughter," Calum said. "He's going through a divorce but, legally, she's not his ex-wife yet. Emily turns up out of the blue wanting to finalise the divorce and Dee-Dee sees it all on the CCTV it all unravels then."

‌  

Calum continued: "I think Joel had been waiting for the right time to tell her and it's not come. So the longer he's waited, the more it seems like he's deliberately deceived Dee-Dee. Joel's dug a huge hole and it doesn't look good. Joel needs to do his grovelling, he absolutely needs to do his grovelling and he needs to make it up to her."

![Image 3](https://i2-prod.mirror.co.uk/article32105518.ece/ALTERNATES/s650/0_ERR_WOL_120224_msvalentines_13jpeg.jpg)

Calum said he had the support of his girlfriend Roberta

![Image 6:  Calum Lill ](https://i2-prod.mirror.co.uk/article32111871.ece/ALTERNATES/s1200e/0_Corrie-hunk-Calum-Lill-hopes-Joel-and-Dee-Dee-will-be-able-to-stay-together-after-she-learns-about-h.jpg)

The actor worked in car sales for two years before landing his Corrie role(Image: @calumlill/Instagram)

‌  

Before joining Corrie, Calum had other soap roles, but he also worked non-acting jobs. "I worked festivals for a year in 2022," Calum shared. "I did this paella stand and it was amazing, I'd gone from being locked inside to being at a festival five days a week. But I was a bit down because if you're working class and northern, all you want to do is something on [Coronation Street](https://www.mirror.co.uk/all-about/coronation-street). I thought: 'It's just not going to happen'. Then I was selling cars, I was rubbish at it and I didn't enjoy it."

Joel's actor, Calum, revealed that his real-life girlfriend was overjoyed when he landed the role on Coronation Street after a two-year dry spell. "My girlfriend Roberta is incredible," said Calum. "When I told her I got the role, she was screaming and crying. I was crying too. She knew I'd been putting on a brave face and it was a huge relief that 15 years of hard work paid off."

Calum admitted: "I'd not worked in acting for two years when Corrie said they wanted to see me. The next day I screen tested and they said I'd know by half ten the following day. Half ten came and went when my agent called. I thought they were calling to tell me I'd not got it. I walked out onto the forecourt, I was between two cars.

Article continues below

"My agent said: 'Calum?' There was a silence that lasted for about ten minutes and then I heard 'You got it'." Overwhelmed with emotion, Calum recalled: "Like the absolute drama queen that I am, I just fell to my knees and was crying and sobbing, I couldn't speak. I was over the moon."

![Image 2: The ITV soap has signed up actor Calum Lill, who is best known for playing P.C. Carlton Smith in the Channel 4 soap in 2021.](https://i2-prod.birminghammail.co.uk/article27618046.ece/ALTERNATES/s1200e/0_calum.jpg)

View Image

The ITV soap has signed up actor Calum Lill, who is best known for playing P.C. Carlton Smith in the Channel 4 soap in 2021.

ITV Coronation Street has moved to sign up a Hollyoaks villain in a soap crossover – and it’s good news for Dee-Dee. The [ITV](https://www.birminghammail.co.uk/all-about/itv) soap has signed up actor Calum Lill, who is best known for playing P.C. Carlton Smith in the [Channel 4](https://www.birminghammail.co.uk/all-about/channel-4) soap in 2021.

‌  

During his time on Hollyoaks, Calum had a big part in John Paul McQueen's storyline which saw his boyfriend, PC George Smith, abuse him. Sources have claimed Calum will be playing duty solicitor Joel Deering on the much-loved soap [Coronation Street](https://www.birminghammail.co.uk/all-about/coronation-street).

‌  

"Callum’s been filming for a few weeks and his character couldn’t be more different from PC Smith on Hollyoaks," said a source to the Sun newspaper. "He’ll be on screen next week as part of Dee-Dee’s new storyline."

‌  

[**READ MORE Dan Walker flooded with complaints as fans say 'sorry' and announce boycott**](https://www.birminghammail.co.uk/news/showbiz-tv/dan-walker-flooded-complaints-fans-27617493)

His character is said to arrive on the show to help Lauren Bolton, and will reportedly grow rather close to Dee-Dee. Calum played PC Carlton Smith on Hollyoaks for 12 episodes - but it’s not the only show he has bagged roles in.

Article continues below

In 2018 he appeared in three short films - I Can See Clearly Now, Sleep Warm, and Heads or Tails. A year later, he starred in Holby City, playing Chez Wilson-Needham, and also appeared in Brummie soap Doctors the same year, playing Conor Henson.

On Hollyoaks, his character Carlton visited John Paul to tell him that George had been murdered in an altercation with four men. This was later revealed to be false, and planned by George to supposedly show John Paul how much he needed George. Merely a few days later, George was beaten to death with a bookend.

Carlton, believing John Paul to be guilty, attempted to tamper with evidence to have him arrested - even going as far as to falsely claim that he witnessed John Paul kill George.

The actor joined the ITV soap last year as new solicitor Joel
-------------------------------------------------------------

[Coronation Street](https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/all-about/coronation-street) fans have discovered the truth about Joel Deering after months of suspicion. Viewers of the [ITV](https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/all-about/itv) soap haven't trusted the solicitor ever since he arrived in Weatherfield as a duty solicitor helping Lauren [Bolton](https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/all-about/bolton).

But his eyes soon wandered elsewhere and was soon inviting Weatherfield solicitor Dee-Dee Bailey out for a drink, explaining that he needed to pick her brain about US law. But it was actually just a ruse as he hoped to land a date with Dee-Dee and the pair have since slipped into a relationship.

However, Dee-Dee was left gutted in recent scenes as, after some digging from Alya Nazir, Joel was left confessing the truth to his new girlfriend - that he has a wife and a one-year-old daughter.

**READ MORE: [Coronation Street star 'burst out crying' over storyline as co-star sweetly thanks him](https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/news/tv/coronation-street-star-burst-out-28687198)**

**READ MORE: [Read more of our Coronation Street stories here](https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/all-about/coronation-street)**

Joel has now been left begging for Dee-Dee's forgiveness, explaining that he is in the process of divorcing his wife but has been battling to see his young daughter.

But with Joel at the forefront of Corrie's latest scandal, what do we know about the actor who plays him, Calum Lill? Before joining Corrie, Calum could be found flogging cars as he took on different jobs - including a stint at Junkyard Golf Club - in between acting gigs - which included an appearance in 2021 on Hollyoaks in which he played PC Carlton Smith in the Channel 4 soap.

But Calum's big break actually came shortly after he graduated. "I had one episode on Doctors – it was two days filming and you’d think I’d just been cast as the lead in the new Scorsese epic," he laughed when speaking to the Manchester Evening News. He went on: "Then I did an episode on Holby City which was fantastic and then lockdown hit... That threw a spanner in the works."

And Calum was soon creating a link with some former Corrie stars. After eventually getting 12 episodes of Hollyoaks in 2021, he ended up working on a paella stand at festivals, working for Jenny Platt and Rupert Hill.

"The owner of it, his brother is Rupert \[Hill\] and his partner Jenny \[Platt\], they used to be in Coronation Street," he said, speaking of the actors who portrayed Jamie Baldwin and Violet Wilson in the show with it recently confirmed that Jenny will be temporarily returning to the cobbles.

He added: "I’d had an unsuccessful audition at Corrie before and they said, 'If they like you, they will get you back in, do not worry'. I was a bit down because if you’re working class and northern, all you want to do is something on Coronation Street."

Calum has moved to Manchester with his girlfriend and worked alongside acting to save for a house, describing the experience as "tough". He went on: "Then it came along and I've never felt anything like it. I was walking on air. I felt incredible – especially being a working class northern lad. To know I've got a part in an institution like Coronation Street, it's the most incredible thing."

Speaking of his girlfriend Roberta Mcclarron's reaction to him getting the part, Lill said: "It wasn't just happiness for me getting the job, she knew what I was going through and that I was struggling. I wasn't happy in the job that I was doing. She knew that I was putting on a brave face, but how down I was. It was a relief that 14 or 15 years had paid off and I wouldn't have to quit. There's no shame in quitting. So many people have to. It's one of the hardest industries to get into. But to know I didn't have to was incredible."

And Calum and Roberta, who works in PR and marketing, are very clearly loved-up. Back in early December, the pair celebrated their anniversary fo Calum sharing a string of snaps of them both on social media. "Three years of mischief," he typed in the Instagram caption, adding: "Here’s to many more. Love you @robertamcclarron."

16.content:
**Major [_Coronation Street_ spoilers](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/) follow from Friday's episode (November 15).**

_Coronation Street_ star Calum Lill has spoken about the outcome [of the Joel Deering murder mystery](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a62806451/coronation-street-spoilers-joel-killer-reveal-episode/) for the first time.

[Friday's special flashback episode](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a62792769/coronation-street-spoilers-joel-killer-finally-revealed/) brought the whodunit storyline to a head, as viewers discovered that Lauren Bolton was responsible for striking the killer blow that ended Joel's life.

What to Read Next
-----------------

This moment marked the end of Calum's time in the role of evil Joel, as all of the scenes that he filmed before leaving the cast have now aired.

Calum recently caught up with **Digital Spy** and other press to talk about the big episode.

![Image 1: joel deering on the rail track in coronation street](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/coronation-street-joel-deering-6737b551ea0e5.jpg?resize=980:*)

Danielle Baguley//ITV

**Did you always know who killed Joel?**

"At first, we were all really confused and trying to work out what was going on, because we were getting snippets of this and snippets of that.

"I eventually found out maybe a couple of months before shooting that it was going to be Lauren, but also that there would be so many twists and turns along the way.

"I thought: 'This is going to be good! If we're trying to piece it all together, hopefully the audience are going to get the same effect'."

**How did you feel about Lauren being the killer?**

"Soap justice is definitely a thing and I think that's the best justice Joel could have got. He didn't deliberately try to kill Lauren, but he attacked her viciously and nearly killed her.

"For it to now come full circle and for him to get his comeuppance from the person that he attacked, when she was vulnerable and defenceless, I think it's what he deserves."

**Did Joel really think he could get away with his crimes by faking his own death?**

"I think he did! He's so blindly arrogant of his own skill and his own ability, that he thinks he's more intelligent than Lauren, the police and the detectives, so of course he's going to get away with it.

"He thinks he's really intelligent and he's male so he's better than DS Swain, you know? So of course, in his head, he was going to get away with it.

"In a way, probably his own sheer arrogance was a big part of his downfall. He completely thought that he could treat women however he wanted and he'd have no repercussions."

![Image 2: lauren bolton, joel deering and max turner in coronation street](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/coronation-street-lauren-bolton-max-turner-joel-deering-6737b4f1d7f17.jpg?resize=980:*)

Danielle Baguley//ITV

**Joel's true nature was hidden from the viewers for a while. Was that fun to play?**

"It was! At first, because I had to be under the radar, I had to be as beige as possible for as long as possible! As the relationship developed with Channique \[Sterling-Brown\], who plays Dee-Dee, we could then find these really genuine moments.

"But once they said 'cut, scene complete', we'd look at each other like: 'She doesn't know what's coming, does she?'"

**The writers also put forward [Joel's secret wife and child](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a46727525/coronation-street-spoilers-joel-deering-secret/) as his big secret…**

"Yes, one of the plans was: 'He can't be perfect, so let's put in some sort of bad background and then hopefully that'll be a red herring'."

**What was it like to film all of the extra flashback scenes?**

"I kind of left and came back. I finished in July really, then just came back to film my final episode. It was nice to come back and see everyone.

"But when I came back, it was like we were filming a movie. We spent 12 hours shooting one of the scenes. We had all these different cameras, green screens and special effects. I've never experienced anything like that before, so it was incredible.

"There have been so many different aspects of playing Joel. I've played him nice, I've played him funny, I've played him boring, I've played him horrific, then I've managed to film scenes on location and also on this movie set.

"Where we were filming, it was [the _Peaky Blinders_ movie](https://www.digitalspy.com/movies/a62448688/cillian-murphy-peaky-blinders-netflix-first-look/) there, [_House of Guinness_](https://www.digitalspy.com/tv/a61707384/steven-knight-netflix-series-house-of-guinness-cast/), [_The Talamasca_](https://www.digitalspy.com/tv/ustv/a62424965/downton-abbey-elizabeth-mcgovern-the-talamasca/), these big Hollywood films and then us. It was incredible to have gotten that opportunity."

![Image 3: coronation street cast film railway bridge scenes for joel deering's exit](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/coronation-street-cast-railway-bridge-6737ba41b9ddb.jpg?resize=980:*)

Danielle Baguley//ITV

![Image 4: paddy bever, calum lill and cait fitton behind the scenes at coronation street](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/coronation-street-paddy-bever-calum-lill-cait-fitton-6737b9e749512.jpg?resize=980:*)

Danielle Baguley//ITV

**_Corrie_ used [volume wall technology](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a41074657/coronation-street-spoilers-kelly-neelan-exit-hollywood-technology/) for these scenes, so the railway bridge location was actually indoors in a studio. Can you tell us more about that?**

"It was in Gorton in a massive black room. The ceiling was probably about 70 feet high. There was a massive semi-circle of screens and then we were set in the middle. We had this long railway bridge that we'd built and that was on a table that turns.

"So instead of the camera moving, the camera stayed where it was, the train track moved and the whole background was synced with the cameras.

"They went out to the real bridge, took 360 views of the whole place and then wired the camera up so the background scenes could change."

**You've often posted [your real-life nan's reaction](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a60976753/coronation-street-calum-lill-joel-twist-nan-reaction/) to key Joel episodes. Will you watch this one with her?**

"I think I'll have to! I get a text still after every episode. She watches all of them. The last one she texted me was: 'Blinking eck, is Kit in the frame now? You really know how to antagonise people! I'm so glad it's not real'. She's so adorable."

"I replied and said: 'Oh yeah, I'm behind but thanks for watching'. She said: 'I watch it every time! You were really bad, that's a compliment. As always, so proud'."

**How proud are you of your work on _Corrie_?**

"I hadn't worked for two years before this and I really struggled to find my feet as I started. For about six months, when watching the episodes back, I was beating myself up. I'd watch the episodes with my fiancée and I'd go upstairs and she'd know to leave me for a bit. It took that time to try and get into the character.

"I worked so hard. I know that there's definitely better actors than me, but I don't think anybody else could have put in as much work as I did. Because I just said: 'If I can give this 100% and I leave and I don't work for years, at least I know that there's no more I could have done'.

"For that, it was getting up at 5.30am. I'd come into work and would be there for about 15 hours. I'd get home for about 10.30pm at night, I'd eat some food quickly and then I'd do another two hours of learning lines and then do it again. That could go on for about three or four months when I was busy.

"Looking back, I'm finished and I can sleep now! I have more time and I can see my friends. But that's probably the happiest time I had. It was amazing. I am proud of my work, not necessarily because I think I'm great, but because I've not had that opportunity to work that hard before.

"I'm proud of what I did, but also feel so honoured and proud of everyone else involved. There were hundreds of people involved in the making of this storyline. I've been put at the front of it and get the compliments in the street, but there's hundreds of people working on the set – the costume, the make-up, the lighting, everything.

"I'm so grateful to be given the opportunity and I miss it at _Corrie_ so much. I miss the people so much because they're just the most incredible people. Although I only got 15 months here, it was the best time of my life."

![Image 5: joel, dee dee bailey, ed bailey, coronation street](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/joel-dee-dee-bailey-coronation-street-651e7e0ce7fcc.jpg?resize=980:*)

ITV

**Do you miss your on-screen partnership with Channique?**

"Yeah, I do. But me and my and \[my fiancée\] Roberta are going over to hers for dinner so I still see her."

**Have you taken anything of Joel's with you?**

"I've got loads of his costume. His smart casual stuff is nicer than any of my smart stuff, so I'm absolutely kitted out now!

"I've also got the murder weapon at home. It's like a brick that would have been part of the bridge, so I've got the foam soft version. It was not soft enough to be hit as hard as I was getting hit in the face repeatedly by Cait \[Fitton, who plays Lauren\], but softer than a brick nonetheless!

"Duncan Foster, the director, was saying to Cait: 'We can tell that you're being too gentle with him, go on, he's a big lad!' I was like: 'Cait, we've worked on this, this is the final episode, we've worked together for so long, let's sell this, this is the last bit, go for it'. She did!

"Luckily the next day of filming was just being dead on the train track, which was good because I needed a lie down! That's what I did for the next 12 hours."

**What are you up to next?**

"I'm doing panto in Bournemouth. I'm playing the baddie in _Jack and the Beanstalk_. Obviously the baddie in _Jack and the Beanstalk_ is the giant, so there's a 3D giant and he's got a normal human sized henchman in lycra and a green top hat, which will be me!

"I was reading the script the other day and my approach for Joel was like: 'What's he thinking? What's he doing?' I was listening to dark music and rocking in a corner.

"I was trying to do the same for this, but then I was looking at a gag to the audience about magic beans vs baked beans and realised I don't need to tear myself into pieces in a corner listening to scary music! I think it's going to be a nice welcome break from attacking teenage girls.

"I've got an unbroken streak of playing villains. Maybe one day someone will give me the chance to play someone who's not a baddie, we'll see."

**_Coronation Street_** **airs on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays at 8pm on ITV1 and streams on** [**ITVX**](https://www.itv.com/)**.**
